summary: Conviction under IPC s.302, 201, 34; child witness testimony upheld; tutored testimony test applied; circumstantial evidence assessed; burden under Evidence Act s.106 examined; High Court acquittal overturned; conviction restored; prosecution case sustained on appreciation of oral and circumstantial evidence, including seizure and site details.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; impugned acquittal set aside; conviction and sentence restored.
